title: Sensors on a parallelogram frame
body: Engineers are fixing four motion sensors at the corners of a flat parallelogram-shaped frame suspended inside a large hall. They set up a three dimensional coordinate system with the origin at one corner of the floor, the x and y-axes along two adjacent walls and the z-axis vertical, with all lengths in metres. Three sensors have already been placed at A(3, -1, 2), B(1, 2, -4) and C(-1, 1, 2). The fourth sensor D must complete the parallelogram ABCD, taken in this order. The engineers remember that the diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other, so the midpoint of AC must coincide with the midpoint of BD. They also plan to check their answer with the distance formula by confirming that opposite sides AB and CD are equal in length.
